name: home1
js: const c=__bw.ctl, T=__bw.THREE; const camp=__bw.scene.getObjectByName('attackerCamp'); if(!camp) return {camp:false}; const bb=new T.Box3(); camp.traverse(o=>{ if(o.isMesh){ const b=new T.Box3().setFromObject(o); if(isFinite(b.min.x)) bb.union(b);} }); const ct=bb.getCenter(new T.Vector3()); c.target.x=ct.x; c.target.z=ct.z; c.dist=120; return {camp:true,n:camp.children[0]&&camp.children[0].count};

name: start
js: const T={levels:{keep:18,wall:18,towers:18,barracks:12,lair:12},seed:11,ratio:1.1,power:4500,loot:{turq:60,emerald:60,ruby:60},tesla:0,emblem:'swords',name:'Navid'}; __bw.battle.start(T,null,null); for(let i=0;i<1200;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); if(__bw.battle.session && !__bw.battle.loading) break; } const S=__bw.battle.session; S.cam.intro=0; return {ok:!!S, camp:!!S.camp};

name: camp0
js: const S=__bw.battle.session; S.hud.el.style.display='none'; const dp=S.sim.deploy; const cx=dp.x+dp.nx*62+(-dp.nz)*(-24), cz=dp.z+dp.nz*62+dp.nx*(-24); S.cam.tx=cx; S.cam.tz=cz; S.cam.dist=105; S.cam.az=S.cam.az0+Math.PI*0.9; return {c:[cx|0,cz|0]};

name: camp1
js: const S=__bw.battle.session; S.cam.dist=170; S.cam.az=S.cam.az0; S.cam.tx=S.sim.deploy.x; S.cam.tz=S.sim.deploy.z; S.hud.el.style.display=''; return 1;
